author: Kushal
body: Even though ours was short visit, it was a great stay at the house. Everything was as expected and as shown in the photos. The hosts were very prompt and communicative. And the location is a huge plus, considering that it's in the middle of the city. We will definitely consider it for our next visit to Mangalore. Response from Rasha 2 weeks ago Thankyou you so much for your valuable feedback. Were glad you enjoyed your stay.

author: Vignesh
body: A wonderful place to stay, with an ideal location that makes it easy to explore the surrounding area and reach other destinations. The host was friendly, responsive, and proactive throughout, making the stay even more enjoyable.

author: Pragadeeshwaran
body: Beautiful place. They thoughtfully put everything in that place, you have pretty much everything available in the house. There was no need to bother the host at all. Location is also great, close to all the restaurants. Hassle free checkin and check-out

author: Anitha N
body: Had a wonderful stay! The location is excellent and very convenient for getting around. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free. There’s a general store right next to the property, which was extremely useful. The AC worked perfectly, and the home is equipped with plenty of amenities—especially helpful for families. Overall, a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Highly recommended!

author: Evian
body: Great homely stay right in the middle of the city. Had all the listed amenities and matched the description and the photos. The hosts are very approachable and quick to respond to any queries. Great restaurants around the place and at walkable distance. Very good option to stay in city center.

author: Konark
body: Really enjoyed my stay here. The space was neat, well-maintained, and had a very homely feel. The host was welcoming and always available if needed. Everything from check-in to checkout was hassle-free. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting!

author: Vishwas
body: Heart of the city, but away from clutter. Easy to reach. All neat and clean. Basic amenities are well equipped. No complaints. Would love to visit again Response from Rasha 2 weeks ago Thankyou for your valuable feedback.

author: Eliezer Jonathan
body: It was a pleasant stay. The house was kept clean for the most part and we had access to whatever we needed, including supplies. The host was friendly as well.

author: Pramith
body: A beautifully maintained and classy apartment that made for a very comfortable stay. The space is thoughtfully designed, elegant, and has a warm, welcoming feel. The host was extremely responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout. Overall, a wonderful experience and a place I’d be happy to stay at again.

author: ⁨Josephchandy10⁩
body: We had a really wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and everyone in our group thoroughly enjoyed it. The atmosphere was peaceful and welcoming, making our stay truly relaxing and memorable.

author: Namyukta
body: , · Group trip We had a wonderful stay at Saurabh’s place in Mangalore. The property was extremely clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. Saurabh was incredibly helpful throughout our stay, from making the check-in process smooth to suggesting great places and options to visit around Mangalore. He was always easily accessible and quick to respond whenever we needed anything. Overall, it was a great experience, and we would definitely recommend Saurabh’s place to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay in Mangalore.

author: Pramit
body: Saurabh was an excellent host, and his place was exactly as advertised. Saurabh's place is very well located and Saurabh has great taste. Do try out his recommendations! Would like to visit again.

author: Adhi
body: We had a wonderful stay and truly enjoyed our time at this property. The place was exactly as described clean, comfortable, well maintained, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The Saurabh was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to checkout, Saurabh ensures, he always available to help whenever we had a question and ensured we felt at home throughout our visit.

author: Dilip
body: First of all I shud say thanx to Saurabh… he just helped out in every way… he is great host… and regarding place it’s just like photos…   We dint face Any issues and check in was smooth…   And  as property is in top floor u hav good view of surroundings and  blissful weather…

author: Saugata
body: Saurav is a super host, very responsive, tries to help for everything. House is really neat, great place to stay and everything was available for day to day activities in the house( felt all the minute details are taken care off).all the things mentioned in the b&b description was matched 100%. As i was having a bigger car, i had some parking issue…however i have got a better parking place later. Overall an excellent stay

author: Ahmed
body: Saurabh was proactive and the description matched the apartment. The apartment was clean and well lit. 14th Level makes it  calm & breezy if not raining. Liked the overall experience.

author: Manisha
body: We had a wonderful stay with Hema! She is a wonderful host and took care of all our needs and was very accommodating.. made us feel very welcome. The apartment is also very nicely maintained and well planned. The location is also quite close to the main madikeri market which saves us a lot of time.. overall we spent a perfect two days and looking forward to be back.

author: Aiswarya
body: It was a pleasant stay at Tavishi's and Hema's place. The property was clean. All the required amenities were provided especially in the kitchen. The host was warm and welcoming.

author: Ashwini
body: We stayed in Madikeri for four days and had a really nice experience. The rooms were clean and comfortable, which made our stay very easy and relaxed. A special mention to Hema Aunty, she was very friendly and cordial throughout our stay. She helped us with breakfast, guided us on places to visit, and even shared local specialties, which made our trip much better. Overall, it was a smooth and pleasant stay. Would definitely recommend this place if you’re visiting Coorg 😊 Response from Tavishi And Hema April 2026 Thank you so much for your appreciation and rating. We are honoured. It was a pleasure hosting you all.

author: Nitin
body: Stayed in Hema's place for 3 days with family and had a very peaceful and enjoyable stay. Grocery store was 5 mins away so cooking was easy and restaurants are also nearby. Definitely recommend Hema's place for those visiting Madikeri and looking for a home away from home. Response from Tavishi And Hema May 2026 Thank you so much for your appreciation and rating. We are honoured. It was a pleasure hosting your family, God bless your family

author: Varun
body: Well maintained and clean property set in very peaceful surroundings. The host, Ms. Hema, lives on the ground floor and was extremely friendly. We had some lovely conversations with her during the stay. The property itself is beautifully maintained, with plenty of plants, small ponds, and fish, which adds to the calm and relaxing atmosphere. Response from Tavishi And Hema March 2026 Thank you so much for your appreciation and rating. We are honoured. It was a pleasure hosting you all. I would definitely wish to host you again

author: Swayambhu Jyoti
body: We had a wonderful stay at Hema's homestay. Hema welcomed us warmly and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. Finding the property was a little challenging initially, but once we located it, everything was smooth and hassle-free. The homestay was clean, well-maintained, and had a peaceful, homely atmosphere. Hema also offers breakfast and dinner, though it's a good idea to check with her in advance regarding the arrangements. If you prefer, you can cook your own meals, and both Swiggy and Zomato are available for food delivery. One of the best things about this place is its location. It's close enough to the city center to be convenient, yet situated on a hilltop where it's calm, quiet, and perfect for relaxing. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend Hema's homestay to anyone visiting Madikeri. Thank you, Hema, for your wonderful hospitality!

author: Bhawana
body: Very beautiful, warm and welcoming place with great hosts. Definitely would like to visit again sometime.

author: Anushka
body: The place was very nice and cozy additionally hema ji was very proactive, friendly and helpful. Worth the money

author: Kishan
body: We had a very nice time staying at The Chalet, the host, Rakshith was friendly and was upfront in terms of communication. He gave us a house tour and helped us for some local sightseeings as well. The place was maintained well (could be better) but suited our needs. Overall I would recommend the place for a short stay (family & friends).

author: Chetan
body: Great place to stay in Coorg, offering privacy and tranquillity despite being centrally located. The villa was beautiful and well-kept. Rakshith, the host, was warm and welcoming, enhancing the experience. We look forward to returning on our next visit to Coorg. Highly recommended for groups of friends and family. Choose this house for a satisfying stay. Thanks, Rakshith, for your hospitality.

author: Abhinab
body: This place is fantastic. The main hall is massive and features a gorgeous fireplace that sets a great mood. It’s also incredibly well-maintained—the washrooms were sparkling clean, which is always a huge plus. Parking was a breeze with tons of space available. Will definitely be coming back!

author: Vinamra
body: We had an amazing stay at The Chalet Villa! Everything was perfectly arranged, and the hospitality was truly outstanding. The place was clean, comfortable, and very well maintained, making our experience relaxing and enjoyable. A big thank you to Rakshith for being such a wonderful host. We would definitely love to visit again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay!

author: Bandana
body: We had a great stay! Check-in was smooth and hassle-free. The place was clean and well-maintained, with fresh beds and towels. The host was very responsive and even provided complimentary milk and snacks, which was a thoughtful touch. The space was comfortable, and we especially loved the flowers in the yard. Would definitely recommend!

author: Simran
body: Rakshith was a great host. We did not face any issues throughout our stay. Overall it was a very pleasant experience. Would live to visit again.

author: Santhosh
body: We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Coorg. The bungalow is spacious, beautifully maintained, and offers a comfortable and relaxing environment for families. Its location is excellent—close enough to the city for convenience while still providing a peaceful and serene atmosphere. The property is clean, well-equipped, and has all the essential amenities needed for a pleasant stay. The rooms are comfortable, the common areas are inviting, and the overall upkeep of the bungalow reflects the care taken by the hosts. The surroundings add to the charm, making it a great place to unwind and spend quality time with family and friends. The hosts were responsive and helpful, ensuring that our stay was smooth and enjoyable. We particularly appreciated the combination of space, cleanliness, accessibility, and the homely feel of the property. One small suggestion for improvement would be to consider installing electric geysers in the bathrooms. The existing solar water heating system is env

author: Ramkumar
body: Three of us (college mates) had a 4-day stay here. We had one of the best experiences of our lives thanks to the great hospitality of Rakshit and the convenient location of this Chalet (3 min walk from Convent junction). This Chalet is very, very spacious and interior decor is tastefully done to a luxury standard. Rakshit is very proactive and was able to organise many things at short notice upon our request in the Chalet, such as a microwave oven, yoga mat, beers etc. He introduced me to his dad, who took me out for a round of golf at the Mercara Downs GC - all arranged including a golf cart and golf clubs! I was very touched. There are many restaurants nearby serving local cuisine. We have decided to come back here again next year.

author: Mozart
body: Samiran Bose received us well, and showed around the house. A very nice house indeed with air conditioning in all rooms (considering the temperature in Pondy), perfect for a family getaway and safe. Best aspect would be that everything is in walkable distance from the location be it the Promenade Beach, or the Cafes, or the French Colony or the Sunday Bazaar. Would recommend!

author: Vijayakumar
body: We fell in love with the place as soon as we entered. It is same as shown in the photos. A well designed and perfect location near to beach and other restaurants. All details were provided and explains clearly during checkin. All amenities were available for self cooking also. Our family loved the place especially the interior designed with Paris theme. Definitely recommend to stay for more days

author: Anand
body: The place is situated right at the heart of white town. All the major attractions are at a walking distance. For the price, this place was a steal. Place in itself was enough for 6 people. The staff was very responsive and helpful.

author: Sriharish Varma
body: Highly recommend this place if you're visiting Pondy with family. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and everything works perfectly. Huge shoutout to Punit and his team for being so responsive-they handled our check-in seamlessly and even replaced a fan within two hours of us mentioning it. The daily housekeeping was great, and there’s plenty of safe parking outside with CCTV. Location-wise, it’s super convenient since the beach, shops, and cafes are within walking distance, and quick commerce apps deliver in minutes. Will definitely book this spot again!

author: Manas
body: The place is exactly as shown in pictures. Rooms are spacious & well maintained. One has everything that is needed for the stay. Parking is on road side, but no issues finding right infront of the house. Location is awesome. Rock beach is just 2mins away. Good restaurants near by. Manager Samiran Bose was courteous - clarified all the queries.

author: Gaurav
body: It was a great experience staying at this house, and everyone felt right at home staying here. Mr. Punit was a great host and very accommodating and responsive to our requests. The proactive ownership of the house help to keep the place immaculate was also much appreciated. Overall a great experience with regards to both the house and the location.

author: Mubarak
body: We had an amazing stay at Puneet’s place . Place is located in beautiful French quarters of Pondy . Puneet even helped us to move our luggage to his villa and offered all possible help Rooms are very clean and washroom too It has small kitchen which is apt to warm the food and has oven and kettle too Looking forward to stay with Puneet again Cheers !!!

author: Saritha
body: We had a wonderful stay at this villa! The property was clean, spacious, and beautifully maintained. The rooms were comfortable, the atmosphere was peaceful, and the staff was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. The villa had all the amenities we needed, making it feel like a home away from home. Perfect place for a relaxing vacation with family and friends. Highly recommended, and we would definitely love to visit again!

author: Sandeep
body: Thank you so much for your appreciation. It means a lot to us.

author: Abhishek
body: The unique stay on a cliff with an amazing view, big windows, beautiful lawn. If you are ok with some level of isolated relaxation, this is the place for you. Expect to encounter wildlife as this cliff sits right at the edge of the forest, we spotted dear, monkeys, boar and more. Getting to the spot is a bit tricky, follow exact route shared by host and it should be good.

author: Karan
body: Beautiful location and a huge house. The view from the garden is mesmerizing. Visited with my family and all of us, including our toddler enjoyed a lot. The only concern is that the kitchen, although fully loaded, needs replacement of utensils and the house overall needs some deep cleaning to get rid of the stains. The owner also asked for additional money for kitchen usage but since it was not mentioned in the description, she let it go. Overall a memorable stay.

author: Shobhit
body: We had a fantastic stay at The Hermitage! It’s every bit as peaceful and beautiful as the name suggests. It is about 10km away from the main town of Ooty, but that wasn't an issue since we had our own car. The property is in great shape, and the cook and caretaker were absolute stars. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unplug!

author: Anitha
body: The place was totally away from the hustle and bustle of Ooty  city - Which we wanted the most .. the place was spacious , clean and comfortable , well maintained - if you can ant to totally switch off from the outside world and stay amidst nature - go for it ! The cook was courteous and prepared food according to our taste —

author: Abhishek
body: It was a beautiful house with a great view. However we felt there was a too much house flies in the premises... we open the door for 10 minutes and the whole house gets filled with flies.. becomes difficult to even have food. Felt few things as rip off our money like a dinner costed us 2300 for a curry chappati and dry item. Asked for a bon fire and was told 1500 for the same. The place to property was 10 kms from the city and the road is way too small and was always Jammed. The house was very big and beautiful indeed.

author: Kutubuddin
body: The host sheila was extremely kind, supportive, and always available whenever needed. The caretakers and helper were also very helpful, polite, and caring, which made the experience even better for my parents. The location was beautiful, peaceful, and perfect for a relaxing stay. Everything was well maintained and the hospitality was excellent. Highly recommended for families and especially for elderly guests who want a comfortable and stress-free stay.

author: Vivek
body: The Hermitage was an absolutely beautiful and serene getaway. The place is very private, spacious, and surrounded by calming views that instantly help you unwind. We had a great time there—it was the perfect weekend stress buster. One of the best parts was being able to truly disconnect and enjoy simple pleasures. We cooked our own meals, spent peaceful evenings gazing at the stars, and just soaked in the tranquility of the surroundings. The entire experience felt refreshing and rejuvenating. Overall, it’s a lovely place to relax, enjoy nature, and have a memorable, peaceful time.

author: Prathameah
body: This is one of the best homestay we had and all is due to Mr. Sasikumar. His support throughout our stay was wonderful. Location is closed to good restaurants and tea factories. Mr  Sasikumar can also arrange food in the room itself. Surrounding view from the room is wonderful and very silent in the night. So, I highly recommend to stay here with friends or family.

author: Aditya Joe
body: Our only smallest complaint was there was not a very good view of the surroundings because our room was on the ground floor. Having said that, it was a very good stay for the price and the location. Would definitely recommend

author: Ganesh
body: A good place to stay but keep in mind their is no kitchen available and apartments only have bed, wardrobe in room. So its a minimal place if you like minimal you love this palace and trace have great view in morning and evening times. Also caretaker is proactive and help you in getting meals and other requirements fulfilled

author: Satish
body: It was a good stay overall. Rooms were clean. Caretaker Aspak was available whenever required, be it getting the tea/breakfast or booking the cabs for sightseeing. I will surely stay here if I visit Ooty again.

author: Iwin
body: We had an amazing stay and truly enjoyed our time here. The place was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, making it feel like a perfect home away from home. The caretaker, Aju, was extremely helpful and supportive throughout our stay. He was always available whenever we needed assistance and made sure everything was comfortable for us. The service and hospitality were excellent, and you can really see the effort they put into making the stay enjoyable. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a peaceful and comfortable stay. We would be happy to stay here again on our next visit!

author: Abhinav
body: We had a pleasant stay overall. The property was neat and clean, and both bedrooms had very comfortable beds and mattresses, which made for a great night's sleep. The dining table was also a nice addition and worked well for our group. A few small additions could make the experience even better. The kitchen was completely empty, so having a small stove along with some basic utensils, plates, cups, and cooking vessels would be very helpful. A water filter or drinking water dispenser would also be a valuable addition. Providing toiletries like body wash and face wash for guests would further enhance the overall stay. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend this place.

author: Kanchan
body: Thank you Kanchan youll have been great guest too looking forward to hosting youll again.

author: Sushree Supreeti
body: Noted , see youll back soon.

author: Ashwani Kumar
body: Very nice place with open areas around and a big living area, lot of parking area. Easy to commute to main tourist attractions specially with own vehicle.Pawan is a senstive and caring host, and caretaker is very helpful. I recommend fellow travelers to must avail the facility when in Mysuru. Over all a very comfortable over four nights. I shall surely revisit.

author: Mithlesh Kumar Tripathi
body: Excellent Property & Hospitality! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ​Had a brilliant stay at Eraya Abode with my family of 6. The property was clean, spacious, and very comfortable. A special thanks to the property manager, Krishna, who was incredibly helpful and made our check-in and stay entirely seamless . Great location in Vijaynagar. Highly recommended! Response from Pawan June 2026 Thank you so much for the review 🙏🏻

author: Subham
body: this place is way beautiful then you see the picture 🖼️ , your window is more then worth the money 💰 you pay , one thing you might not like is it's wifi 😔 it slow very slow not reachable also .I stayed for around 7 days so felt they should have wifi extender it's cheap as well. food is awesome .bisons and peacock 🦚 will be your neighbour for sure every day morning 🌞 and 🌆 evning you will find them around property.its really 🕊️ peaceful.

author: Shashwat
body: This is a great place to chill out. I went there for the weekend and had a good relaxing time. Breakfast served was great. Views around is good. One can easily go for long walks both in morning and evenings. I would suggest should start serving lunches atleast if not Dinner. Overall a really good expirience and I am definitely coming back.

author: Satyadeep
body: Felt like home. ❤️ If you’re someone trying to reconnect with yourself, this is the perfect place to stay. The peace and tranquility here are truly refreshing. The only minor issue is the network/Wi-Fi, but Airtel has good coverage, so I didn’t face much trouble. The breakfast was lovely! 🥳❤️ I stayed here for two nights, and every moment was peaceful. I was lucky enough to spot Indian gaurs (often called forest buffaloes), along with lots of birds and insects—a complete blend of flora and fauna. Played basketball as well🙌🙌 I came here on a solo trip, booked a two-night stay on a whim, and it turned out to be one of the best decisions. If you’re looking for a quiet escape surrounded by nature, I’d definitely recommend this place.

author: Shyam
body: I booked a bachelor's room, and it was the most beautiful room I had ever seen. I felt so lucky to have it. When I opened both windows, I was greeted by stunning scenic views, and everything was calm and clean. The bed was soft and comfortable, and the room was neat. I loved my room more than anything. The breakfast offered was traditional and delicious. However, the only issue I encountered was with the shared bathroom. To take a shower, we had to go outside to the bathroom, which could be inconvenient. Fortunately, the weather was nice, allowing me to wake up early and take a shower. I can imagine that it would be challenging in colder weather. Beauty comes with a price. Overall, I enjoyed my stay.

author: Sanika
body: The Stumpfields stay is way more beautiful than the pictures. Yes the location and the access is a bit tricky. But they've mentioned everything in their description. The lawns, shrubs, flowers, birds, the eberyday breakfast and the overall English Cottage vibe is on point. Come here if you really want a slow, peaceful stay. Highly recommended for solo travellers.

author: Amitabh
body: Hi Preena, I would have marked 5/5 throughout but there were certain things which made me rate 4/5 at places. One, please ask the local caretaker/manager to not address guests by 'bro' , we aren't here to make relationships, we're here to enjoy our stay and in hospitality business as far as I know and have seen, it's better to address the guest by Mr/Miss (name) or simply Sir or Madam. Kindly, pass on this feedback to your staff Ritesh. Otherwise he was okay. The ladies who come in the morning were good, they made lovely breakfast, the property is beautiful and I'm feeling lucky that I found it, I'll recommend others about it as well, for sure. I'm a nature lover and love places like your stay and it surely didn't disappoint me. Thanks for your hospitality.

author: Abhijeet
body: The place was very cozy & our infant especially had a lot of fun running around the spacious home & loved his time at the place. Thank you for hosting us & accomodating our request at all times! Yes, the in-house parking was tough due to very steep incline but Dheepa communicated that clearly to us even before booking as a disclaimer which I really appreciate! Overall had a good time with my family!

author: Marisha
body: Had a great experience staying here with my family. The location is great, the rooms are very spacious and clean, had all the amenities and Dheepa was really helpful. Overall loved the stay.

author: Naveen
body: seamless checkin, host helped us to reach the destination without any problem. it's a good location walkable to the beach and french settlement. you can park in the road. if you want to park in the property parking you will have challenge with the ramp and the street. ramp is not steep and street is bit narrow. rooms where clean and good furniture. felt like Home. Hall lacks proper ventilation so it makes feel like too much heat sometime. if you open both the door you will get nice breeze but again mosquito will be an challenge. Host left us with the bat and allout. it's a big Hall. bedroom where Big. it's a good stay, will recommend.

author: Rajesh Kanna
body: The house is much bigger than what it appears on photo.  Host was helpful always.  Rock beach, white town, mg road and food street are walkable.   The house had all required appliances like fridge, washing machine, coffee maker & complete kitchen .  it was a memorable stay. We parked along the road as it is difficult to use covered parking.  There were ample parking on the road in front. thanks to AirBnB and Dheepa for making this vacation memorable.

author: Devaraj
body: We had a wonderful stay and Dheepa was incredibly helpful. The place looked exactly as pictured.  The check-in was easy and she provided clear instructions. It felt like home.

author: Moni
body: A very clean and spacious rooms. All the amenities are very good. Just a parking issue otherwise it's a good room to be in. Kitchen amenities are very good and have all the necessary items. The house is super spacious.

author: Geethika
body: Dheepa is so friendly and received very well. She is available always and was very responsive she allowed for late check out and is very understanding home is exactly as shown in the pics and very comfortable for the stay

author: Vigneshwar
body: Show more

author: Luqman
body: Even though we didn’t get a chance to meet Allister and Sallie, their instructions were clear and precise. The place was very nice and sweet as described. We had a beautiful time there. Beach nearby was so peaceful at night since we were looking for a place calm than Goa’s rush. North goa is a bit far but the stay was worth it.

author: Pramod
body: The stay was amazing. Easy to check-in and was provided all the necessary details. Flat looks exactly as shown in pictures and I would recommend this for anyone who loves calm and peaceful stay, thank you Allister

author: Faisal
body: Allister and sailee were amazing host and also the property was extremely maintained they had set instructions which made the stay more convenient would like to stay again highly recommended

author: Banothu
body: This is the first Airbnb that truly matched my expectations. It has everything you need. Every small detail was thoughtfully taken care of. The place was spotless and looked exactly like the photos, which was a huge plus. The helpers were incredibly humble, friendly, and took great care of us throughout our stay, making the experience even better. The only minor downside is that the beach is a bit far to walk (around 15–20 minutes). Other than that, it was a perfect stay. 10/10, would definitely recommend!

author: Johnsy
body: The place was quite clean,serene and peaceful. The apartment had all the things required and the apartment was quite spacious. I would recommend this place to people who likes peace around. There are some really good beaches & good food around this place.

author: Karen
body: We had a wonderful stay here. What really stood out among other AirBnB's was the cleanliness. This was one of the cleanest maintained homes I've seen on AirBnB. The entire society was well maintained, including the pool. Quite well located too.

author: Rakesh
body: The property is amidst nature and absolutely peaceful. There's a lot of things to explore within the property and nearby by walk. The home-made food is top-notch, each and every meal. Sandeep and team made the stay a delightful experience. Will definitely book again.

author: Jaiker
body: Esalen is just like the description and photos, serene and close to nature. Sandeep and his team was always available for any help. Make sure you're exploring the property, especially the tree house and Elevated platform with the amazing view of Kaveri river.

author: Kishore
body: If you're looking for a place to truly disconnect from the noise and reconnect with nature, this resort is a hidden treasure. The silence here is something special, with nothing but the sounds of birds, flowing water and gentle rain filling the air. Every corner feels peaceful, untouched. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for peace, solitude, and a refreshing escape from everyday life. If your soul needs a quiet place to rest, this is one you'll never forget.

author: Anusha
body: I had a wonderful stay at Woodpecker 1 cottage in Esalen Coorg. The place is incredibly peaceful and beautifully maintained, offering the perfect escape into nature. A special mention to our host, Sandeep, whose hospitality was outstanding. He was very welcoming, ensured we had everything we needed, and made us feel right at home. Truly a memorable experience, and I highly recommend this property and Sandeep’s warm hosting

author: Avinash
body: Had a wonderfully relaxing time here — highly recommended!

author: Shikhar
body: Esalen is a beautiful little rainforest retreat if your idea of a vacation is slowing down. The hosts are incredibly warm and welcoming, the home-cooked food was delicious, and the entire property feels peaceful and well cared for. I especially enjoyed walking through the estate, having tea by the river, and spending time in the tree house. Time genuinely slows down here, which is rare these days. One thing future guests should know is that this is a very secluded property. During my stay, I was the only guest, so it felt more like a private retreat than a homestay. That’s perfect if you’re looking for complete solitude, reading, writing, or simply disconnecting. If you’re expecting to meet fellow travellers or have activities nearby, this may not be the right fit. Also, don’t hesitate to ask the staff for guidance while exploring the estate, especially if you’re unfamiliar with the property. Overall, I’m glad I experienced Esalen.

author: Seshant
body: The place was like a dream , squeaky clean , very comfortable and absolutely scenic. The host was very responsive and helpful and the caretaker were so friendly, and nice. They also offered us ripe papayas which was home grown. Well equipped kitchen and all amenities that makes the stay absolutely relaxing. 10/10 recommended to everyone

author: Aniket
body: Wonderful stay and excellent hospitality! We had a great experience here. The place was spotless and very well-maintained, thanks to the caretakers, Das and his family, who went out of their way to be helpful and cooperative. The location is excellent, providing easy access to several nearby beaches. Overall, a fantastic stay—highly recommended!

author: Peter
body: The accommodation is nice but you have to take into maind that it is in a village where there is more nature and therefore insects and wild animals. Really nice and big house where you can find everything. At the house you will find a swimming pool maintained as well as a yard and a house with Ropa and Uma who are available for everything you need.

author: Rohit
body: Had an outstanding One week long stay at this villa in Colva, South Goa. The cleanliness was top notch, everything was spotlessly maintained, from the rooms and bathrooms to the kitchen. Fresh linens and a tidy space made us feel right at home. The small garden is peaceful and well-kept, perfect for relaxing with a cup of tea. The private swimming pool was the highlight — clean, refreshing, and a great place to unwind after a day out. Special thanks to the caretakers Mridul Dass ji and his wife Uma Dass ji. Both were warm, helpful, and always available. Their genuine hospitality made the stay even better. Highly recommend this villa for a clean, comfortable, and peaceful stay in South Goa. Would love to return..

author: Sandip
body: We had a wonderful stay at Sunshine Villa. The villa was exactly as shown in the pictures—clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. The location is peaceful, with all essential shops and restaurants conveniently nearby. A special thanks to the caretakers, Mr. Das and Ms. Uma, for their warm hospitality and helpful nature. They made us feel completely at home. We also appreciate Allister and the entire team for being highly cooperative, responsive, and ensuring a smooth experience throughout our stay. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would love to visit Sunshine Villa again in the future. Highly recommended!

author: Jaya
body: Had an amazing time at Sunshine Villa. The place was tidy including the bathrooms. We got all the required amenities. The balconies have amazing view. Also, Ally was very cooperative and responsive. Overrall we had a great time here!! Would highly recommended this place if you're visiting South Goa.

author: Sanyog Vasant Methawale
body: Wonderful villa in a peaceful yet highly convenient location in South Goa. The beach, bakeries, breakfast spots, and liquor stores are all within walking distance. The villa is spacious and well-maintained, featuring a lovely plunge pool with a waterfall, large bedrooms, a grand living area, and a big dining table perfect for groups. The solar-heated hot water system worked flawlessly, and the quiet surroundings made for a relaxing stay and great sleep. A special thanks to Mr. Das, the caretaker, whose hospitality and willingness to help made our stay even more enjoyable. His dedication and attention to detail, including thoughtful gestures like cleaning our car, were truly appreciated. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing South Goa getaway.

author: Sharolyn
body: "We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful and clean home! It was very comfy and felt safe for our group of six ladies. The amenities were exactly what we needed, and a big thanks to Das and Uma for their assistance throughout our stay. However, there were a few things to note regarding privacy and transport. The caretakers stay in a separate space but within the same home compound; we felt a bit uncomfortable with them walking around while we were at the pool, and an unfamiliar person also stopped by, which made it feel less private. Additionally, the 9 PM pool cutoff meant we mostly used it for photos since we returned late each day.Location-wise, while shops are nearby, the heat and the lonely path at night meant we had to drive everywhere. Taxis are hard to find, and the local drivers' rates were quite high compared to North Goa. Overall, a great house, but better suited for those with their own transport who don't mind a shared compound and a close neighbours.

author: Syed
body: We had a check in at 3 but we were early at the location yet the owner gave us a place to spend some time and rest just beside the BNB. Make no mistake even that place was very comfortable 😌.

author: Neha
body: It is a very good stay for relaxing and spending time with friends or family. All the amenities and Naresh bhaiya(caretaker)’s proactive support in bringing us any groceries was really convenient. We had a really good  time enjoying the aesthetics and the views, playing games, cooking pasta and doing bbq. Even with the non stop rain, the place seemed all the more totally worth it.

author: Ritika
body: We had a fantastic stay at Abhishek’s! He’s an attentive host who regularly checked in to ensure we had everything we needed. Loved the attic room and the pool, and Naresh bhaiya’s home-cooked meals were amazing, plus he’s always smiling and ready to help. Perfect place for a comfortable, happy family stay. Thank you for the warm hospitality!

author: Anoop
body: A very beautiful stay ! The house was well equipped with everything one would need! Cause of the location we had absolute privacy. And the caretaker was incredible! Very helpful and responsive to all our requests! And a great cook too ! Would definitely visit this place again!

author: Ranajoy
body: Lovely cabin in the woods. Very comfortable, well equipped and well maintained. Abhishek was very responsive and helpful host. The caretaker was great and very helpful too. Highly recommend if you are looking for a  cabin in Wayanad.

author: Hirendra
body: A peaceful and beautiful place in the midst of greenery. A total detox from the urban life. Will be back again for sure. The super host and caretaker are always reachable and proactive. The food, pool side bbq, the little hike uphill for the views and the rooms itself are all top notch. Thank you.

author: Roshan Kumar
body: The house was beautiful, with excellent amenities and a great location. We truly enjoyed our stay, especially the delicious home-cooked meals prepared by Naresh, the caretaker. The place offered great privacy, and the hospitality was exceptional. Abhishek was very proactive, responsive, and ensured everything was smooth throughout our stay. Overall, an amazing experience — highly recommended!

author: Madhusimha
body: There are good views from the cabin and balcony, got to spot many birds in the surroundings, peacock's call & fire flies lighting up the trees in the night is a pleasant experience. Inside the cabin, the attic room was our kids favourite with cosy bed and sofa. The barbecue by caretaker Naresh was relishing. City dwellers will appreciate the serene environment and silent nights.

author: Karthik
body: Im delighted to know that you had wonderful time. All the best for your future and we thank you for choosing dales house and looking forward to serve you again. Greg

author: Harsha Vardhan
body: It's an have-all stay for all kind of travellers. It has AC in all rooms, Smart TV with WiFi, Refrigerator, Washing Machine which all works well. Has balconies and located in a peaceful surroundings with absolutely no city noise. Easily accessible from all sides of the city. A good and responsive care taker. Response from Greg June 2026 We're delighted to know that you liked our arrangements for your peaceful stay.we look forward to welcome more of your family and friends. all the best from dales house team.

author: Sabeesh
body: Thanks for staying and the lovely feedback. You had been a great host as well and we would be delighted to host you again.

author: Uma Maheswar Rao
body: Great place and nice hosting , enjoyed our stay with family. pool is neat and  place is really worth and safe for family . Good restaurants are with in 15 mins away. Kitchen is very good with required utensils and induction stove for making any quick dishes and tea.  We enjoyed family time in pool and making barbecue with music playing from the Bluetooth speaker provided at place.  Will visit in future for sure. Thanks Dipam. Response from Dipam July 2026 Thank you so much for staying with us, Uma and family, and for your kind feedback. We truly enjoyed hosting you. Guests like you make hosting a wonderful experience. We hope to welcome you back again soon!

author: Pramila Hemant
body: This is our 2nd time staying in this apartment. It's exactly like pictures. Host is very responsive and proactive. It's near to the airport which is plus point. Cleaning service is the best thing about this apartment. Cleaning lady is also really nice, came every day on time. Place is spotless. Amazing stay. Will definitely stay again next year.

author: Sanjay
body: I had an amazing stay here! The flat was incredibly comfortable and everything was perfectly in place. The service was top-notch. A huge thank you to Vidhi for being so accommodating and kind—she even allowed me to stay an extra hour or two after check-out, which was incredibly helpful. I highly recommend staying here!"

author: Arun
body: The apartment was spacious and bright… close to the airport, but it needs a bit of maintenance . Vidhi was very responsive and helped us very well. overall comfortable stay.

author: Veeral
body: It was a perfect place for peacefully enjoying the weekend with friends. Easy check-in, responsive and polite hosts and caretakers, all amenities available and working, extra sheets and pillows, great mumbai city view, clean bathrooms. Great for house party away from home, had a great time. It feels good to have things available without asking for it as even hand wash, towel, tissues and room freshener backups were available. No neighbour problems at all, smooth car parking, get access to food stores and commuting options easily too.

author: Piyush
body: I stayed with my family here and had a very good experience. The location is near the airport and almost centrally located in Mumbai. The place had all the amenities - AC in both the rooms and the hall, clean washrooms and a decent kitchen with utensils and basic cooking equipment and supplies. The hosts were also easily accessible and upfront with all the communication. Overall a very nice homely vibe. Response from Anuja May 2026 Hi Piyush, Thank you so much for your thoughtful feedback. We’re truly happy to know that you and your family had a very good experience with us. It’s wonderful to hear that you found the location convenient, the apartment well-equipped with all the necessary amenities, and the overall vibe warm and homely. We also appreciate your kind words about our communication and support throughout your stay. Thank you once again for choosing Iconic Stays, and we would love to host you and your family again in the future 😊 Warm regards, Iconic Stays Show more

author: Sarang
body: , · Stayed with kids Perfect stay for families near the airport! We had a wonderful 2-night stay with our kids and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The location was incredibly convenient — just minutes from Mumbai airport, which made our travel so much less stressful. The space was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a family stay. The kids felt right at home! The host was warm, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed from check-in to check-out. Would absolutely recommend to any family passing through Mumbai. We’ll definitely be back! Response from Anuja May 2026 Hi Sarang, Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed feedback. We’re truly delighted to know that you and your family had such a comfortable and stress-free stay with us 😊 It’s great to hear that the location near the airport made your travel easier, and that the space felt clean, comfortable, and well-suited for your kids. We’re especially happy that your little ones felt at home—that truly means a lot to us. Your kind words about our hospitality and responsiveness are deeply appreciated. It was a pleasure hosting you and your family, and we would absolutely love to welcome you back whenever you’re in Mumbai again. Warm Regards, Iconic Stays Show more

author: Sherin
body: Had a lovely time staying here. Babush sir was an excellent host who made our stay smooth and very comfortable. We visited while renovation work was underway, but the place was clean and well maintained, with a charming garden and a pleasant outdoor lounge area. The kitchen is well stocked, and the prime location puts beaches, supermarkets, and dining spots within easy reach. And of course, I can't leave out their adorable resident pup, Moosti !

author: Dhivya
body: we would love to host you again.

author: Vidisha
body: If you’re looking for a budget-friendly stay, go for it without a doubt! The location is excellent, the owners are super homely, and the breakfast is amazing, we had some of the best dosa and puri here! It’s an old property, but it’s clean and hygienic & quite peaceful. For the price we paid, we were more than satisfied with our stay.

author: Rajlaxmi
body: We loved our time at Gagan’s place. Beautiful and peaceful place, main city was reachable in 5 mins drive. Gagans mom n dad (the hosts) were very polite n humble. Aunty also made us a very wholesome breakfast. Gagan helped us connect with the localite who took us for a trek and a private waterfall. Gagan also gave us amazing local food and restaurants recommendations. We really enjoyed staying in his place. Looking forward to visit again

author: Yashin Bopanna
body: We had a wonderful stay at this homestay. The property was comfortable, well maintained, and had a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Gagan was extremely friendly, kind, and always ready to help, making our stay even more special. The hospitality and personal touch truly made us feel at home. Would definitely recommend this place and look forward to visiting again!

author: Naveen
body: We had a fantastic stay at Beehive Homestay. Even though Gagan wasn’t there during our visit, his father, Sudhakar, took great care of us and was an incredibly kind and welcoming host. The homestay is clean, peaceful, and conveniently located near Madikeri town. The homemade breakfast was delicious, and Sudhakar sir was always happy to help with local recommendations and anything we needed. His hospitality truly made our stay special. Highly recommended, and we’d definitely love to visit again!

author: Vanshika
body: the homestay is located in one of the best places in madikeri, the host was very responsive and sweet and the breakfast was very good and overall, i would 110% recommend this place to anyone who is looking to stay in madikeri.

author: Preethi
body: Beautiful place, felt right at the home Gagan helped with travel and his parents were wonderful. They served breakfast on both days I was there, it was absolutely delicious. The place itself is very quiet and peaceful. 30-40 mins(walkable) to most of the tourist places. I loved it. 10/10 would visit again.

author: Arindam
body: It is a very good place to stay in Madikeri, I stayed there for 2 nights, and really enjoyed our stay. It is around 2.5-3km from Madikeri Bus stand and fort. Breakfast was awesome. Overall great place to stay.

author: Shyam
body: We stayed for 3 nights at this place. The atmosphere was amazing and Sudhakar uncle was very friendly and helpful. The place is extremely near to Madikeri main area and hence easily accessible. Overall, we loved the stay.

author: UdayaKumar
body: Fantastic one-day stay in Mysuru! The house is spacious and had everything our group of 6 needed. Mr. Rajeev is a superb, proactive host who checked in on us and even guided us to the door when our auto driver missed the drop-off. Excellent location with very easy access to Rapido, Uber, and Ola for sightseeing. Great experience!

author: Gokul
body: The stay at Prerana was amazing and Rajeev was always available if we needed any help.  I will always recommend this place for groups as it was very spacious, clean and peaceful. Overall this place is one worth every rupees we paid for.

author: Alan
body: Had a wonderful stay with my family, Nice home for families and friends, Rooms are well maintained, easy accessable for blinkit and Instamart, the host was very responsive, thanks to Rajeev the host for your wonderful hospitality we really enjoyed our stay

author: Prachiti
body: It was a great stay with homely feeling. Rajeev was only a call away to ask if we need anything. it's a quiet place with a nice park just besides the property for kids. overall we had a good and homely experience at this property.

author: Kalsang
body: We had a wonderful stay. The room was perfect for our large family of 6 adults and 2 children. It was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. The accommodation included 2 air-conditioned rooms and 1 non-AC room. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free. The location is convenient, with a garden nearby, easy access to stores, and fresh fruits and vegetables available within a short distance. Overall, we had a great experience and truly felt at home. Highly recommended for families and groups.

author: Padmanabhareddy
body: Our stay at Prerna villas was highly satisfactory. Rajeev and his family were exceptionally hospitable, and the house featured three bedrooms- two with air conditioning and essential kitchen utensils, making it well suited for families. Based on this positive experience, I would choose to stay here again when visiting Mysore. My family was very pleased with the overall accommodations.

author: Raam
body: We had a wonderful stay in Mysuru with our family of 7, including 2 kids. The house had a very positive vibe and was clean and tidy throughout. All essentials were neatly arranged and easily available. Rajeev sir was very friendly, down to earth, and always ready to help whenever needed. The big park nearby was a great plus for the kids, and the surroundings were calm and peaceful. Climbing steps to access the bedrooms and kitchen was a different experience, but overall we truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place.

author: Anil
body: I recently stayed at a villa and overall it was a pleasant and relaxing experience. 🏡 The villa offered great privacy, making it perfect for a quiet getaway with family/friends. 🌿 The surroundings were peaceful and scenic, which added to the whole experience. 🛏️ Rooms were spacious and comfortable, with decent cleanliness. 🍽️ kitchen was well maintained and with some utility which helps us to prepare food 👨‍💼 Staff/host were friendly and helpful, responding when needed.

author: Santosh
body: We had an amazing stay and enjoyed this property with our family. Happy with Arpit ji's hosting. Photos what shown on internet and reality are similar..No need to worry about It ..100% we are very satisfied with this Property and definitely Trust me every one will Be happy If they stay here ..  I recommend this villa to  Families/ friends who are Going as A group...price worthy stay definitely

author: Utkarsh
body: Arpit is a great host! Very clear about the instructions for checkin and directions. The place is lovely if you enjoy being close to nature. We’ll love to stay again whenever we are visiting Goa again. Cheers to you Arpit🥂

author: Pallavi
body: We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful 2BHK villa in Goa! The villa was clean, spacious, and tastefully designed, with all the amenities needed for a comfortable vacation. The bedrooms were cozy, the living area was perfect for relaxing, and the private outdoor space added to the overall experience. The host was friendly, responsive, and ensured everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. We  would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway with family or friends. We’d love to stay here again!

author: Sanjay
body: Had a great stay at the property. It is inside a gated community, eventhough it looks secluded, felt very secure and safe. The place is well maintained and also feels very comfortable and cozy. The property is located in such a way that Baga is walkable despite the porperty feels very secluded. Arpit was a great host. He had been friendly since we checked-in and gave us some great recommendations for cafe's and local attractions. We had a few power cuts during our stay which is not in their control, but was a minor hassle. But, the property is beautifully designed, perfect for a couple or a small group. Would definitely recommend this property for anyone who's looking to stay near a happening area but still want to feel secluded and private. Point to be noted, as mentioned in the description, they do not have room service/bell boy services and you can plan your amenities accordingly. The common swimming pool facing the lake was a bliss to spend time in. Definitely recommended.

author: Aizan Ahmad
body: , · Group trip We had an absolutely wonderful stay in Goa! The property is located in a beautiful, peaceful, and lush green society, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind away from the usual hustle and bustle. The host was fantastic….super helpful, responsive, and genuinely welcoming throughout our stay. Whenever we needed anything, they were always ready to assist, and their hospitality made the experience even more memorable. What really stood out were all the thoughtful little touches around the property. They had chess boards and several other board games, which were perfect for spending some relaxed quality time together. There was even a lovely collection of books and novels to read, along with bedtime storybooks for kids. As a group, we really appreciated these small details they made the place feel much more like a home than just another holiday rental.

author: Sujaan
body: We had such a wonderful stay at your property. The accommodations were very comfortable and well-maintained.  It was a perfect little getaway, and we would highly recommend it to others. Thank you for a memorable experience!

author: Kavitha
body: If you’re looking to spend some peaceful time with friends despite a busy schedule, this is the perfect place. It’s incredibly calm, welcoming, and lovely. We had a wonderful time here.❤️ Response from Arpit June 2026 Thank you so much for your lovely review! I'm delighted you and your friends enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and had a chance to relax and unwind together. Creating a comfortable, welcoming space where guests can feel at home is exactly what we aim for. We're glad you enjoyed the villa, the serene surroundings, and your time in Goa. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we'd love to welcome you back for another relaxing getaway soon! ❤️ Show more

author: Ishank
body: The host made my stay so comfortable that it became easy for me. Helped me with everything single thing… looking forward to meet you again Arpit thanks for making my stay so amazing Response from Arpit June 2026 Thank you so much for your wonderful words! I'm truly happy to know you had a comfortable and hassle-free stay. It means a lot that I could help make your experience smooth and enjoyable. I'm glad you were able to relax and enjoy the villa, its peaceful surroundings, and the convenient location close to Goa's beaches, restaurants, and local attractions. Hosting guests like you is always a pleasure, and I'd be delighted to welcome you back for another memorable stay in Goa! Show more

author: Prabhu
body: The hotel staff was great in communication. The rooms were reasonably clean. Bathrooms had stains and dirty marks. The bathroom dustbins were rusted and looked awkward. The staircase were sticked with cello taps...old building so many places the steps were broken. Sofa set was torn from back side but from front it was clean. Refrigerator, ice tray was broken, handle was broken...

author: Kirti
body: The place was exceptionally clean and had a wonderful, positive atmosphere. It's conveniently located close to many popular tourist attractions, making it a great base for exploring the area. The host was very helpful, responsive, and polite throughout our stay. We had a great experience and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area Response from Temple And Thorpe Resorts June 2026 Thank you so very much for staying with TempleAndTowns. It was a pleasure hosting you. We are looking forward to seeing you all back soon 🙏🙏🙏

author: Ritesh
body: Amazing place to just have a nice break from the rush of the city, tucked away amidst mountains. Premjith was an amazing host, was always available to help us with whatever we needed to know. The home cooked dosas and idli with the amazing sambar is a good enough reason for me and my wife to visit again.

author: Mahesh
body: Had a fantastic experience at this property! It was exactly as described—cozy, well-equipped, and very clean. The host was proactive with communication and made the check-in process seamless. It felt like a true home away from home, and the local recommendations provided were a great touch. Highly recommended!

author: Sethuparvathi
body: Such a beautiful stay !!! the place genuinely feels straight out of Bali. Peaceful, scenic, and perfect for a relaxed family getaway. The host made us feel completely at home and accommodated every request so warmly. We had asked him for suggestions on where to get a birthday cake, and he personally brought one for us instead, which was such a thoughtful gesture. Loved the healthy breakfast, the pool, and the overall calming vibe of the place.

author: Saurabh
body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely stunning stay with breathtaking views! Kibbuts Wayanad is one of the best stays I’ve experienced. The property is beautifully designed, surrounded by nature, and the views are simply breathtaking. Waking up to the peaceful greenery and beautiful hills was an amazing experience. The stay is clean, comfortable, peaceful, and perfect for anyone looking to disconnect from the hustle and bustle and spend quality time in nature. The entire property has a unique charm and feels even better in person than in the pictures. Definitely one of the best places to stay in Wayanad. Highly recommended for couples, families, or anyone looking for a peaceful and memorable getaway. Would absolutely love to visit again! ❤️ Response from Premjith E K August 2026 Thank you Saurabh for your kind words. It was our pleasure to get to host you guys. Hope to see you soon again.

author: Sujay
body: Premjith was extremely friendly and approachable. He was very kind to us, and proactively providing service. In morning he himself served the breakfast and had good conversation of local sightseeing. I must recommend this place for unique, customer friendly staff and the breakfast was yum.

author: Ishani
body: The best property in Wayanad!! We had the best time there. Our goal was to simply unwind and enjoy peace and tranquility and the property offered everything and more. The view from the balcony is breathtaking, the aesthetics of the property are amazing and can be rarely found. All the amenities were there to elevate the experience as much as possible. The breakfast was out of the world. And most importantly, Premjith Sir was so lovely and hospitable. He was beyond kind, offered insights to nearby locations and attractions, checked on us to ensure complete support. We cannot thank him for the kindness and generosity. 1000% recommended for anyone who is visiting Wayanad.

author: Alfred
body: We had a wonderful stay and couldn't be happier with our experience. The place was exactly as described in the photos, which made everything feel comfortable and welcoming from the moment we arrived. There were no surprises, just a clean, lovely space that matched what we'd hoped for. We spent quality time together as a family, making memories that we'll treasure for a long time. It was the kind of getaway where everyone could relax, unwind, and simply enjoy being together, which is exactly what we needed.

author: Harsha
body: Had an amazing stay this weekend! The place was clean, comfortable, and very peaceful. What made the experience even more special was the hospitality of the owner, who personally cooked delicious food for us since all the restaurants in the area were closed due to the shutdown. A special mention to Kamal, the helper, who went out of his way to help us with the food and made sure we were comfortable throughout the stay. Truly appreciated the warmth and care. Highly recommend this place! Response from Premjith E K May 2026 Thankyou Harsha, for your kind and elaborate review. It was a pleasure to host you at our property. Hoping to see you soon again. Wishing you the best😊

author: Tarique
body: Property was clean and easy to locate,  Very near from ooty center and was having many restaurants around. Manager Rupam was responsive and assisted us everytime we called.

author: Nabanita
body: The place was neat and clean as described, it was good time with family. However, in one room the plug wasn’t fixed correctly due to which the heater in the room didn’t work properly, rest everything was fine.

author: Manish
body: We had a great experience staying here. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Host was helpful throughout our stay. Overall, it offered excellent value for money, and we'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a pleasant stay.

author: Deep
body: My wife and I had a good stay with our friends at Rahimas place. The home is in beautiful surroundings with easy access to the main market. Karaoke setup was great with the projector screen and my family enjoyed it coupled with pristine clean home.

author: Aayush
body: The location of the stay is nearly in the middle of the city, sites like doddabetta peak, tea garden, botanical Rose garden and others are pretty nearby. The place is also silent and calm. Views from the terrace is nice, at night have a cup of coffee there ends the day well. Neat and clean place. Staff comes for cleaning every morning. Overall great experience. No complaints.

author: Rohit
body: The stay was exactly how it was described in the listing. The surroundings were beautiful but what stood out was how great the service was- the hosts were incredibly kind and helpful.

author: Nipun
body: Would definitely recommend!

author: Naman
body: The place looks exactly like the photos and the view is amazing! Property was extremely well maintained though it has started to show minor signs of wear and tear but nothing alarming. Food availability nearby however was nothing to write home about - plan that accordingly but it has nothing to do with the property and host who were really helpful. Worth visiting again for get together with family and friends. Highly Recommended 5/5.

author: Akansha
body: Had a lovely stay here with my entire family! The place was very clean, convenient, and beautifully done. We were all very comfortable and enjoyed our stay. The only small inconvenience was that someone had to get up to open or lock the main door whenever anyone went out. Other than that, everything was great Response from My Private Stay July 2026 Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 😊 We're delighted to hear that you and your family had a lovely stay and enjoyed the cleanliness, comfort, and overall experience at our villa. Thank you as well for your valuable feedback regarding the main door. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and we'll certainly look into possible improvements to make the stay even more convenient for our future guests. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we look forward to welcoming you and your family back again soon! 🌿 Show more

body: , · Group trip The place was very much like the pictures. We liked that it was corner property with nice views.  It is well maintained with a caretaker who is available on call to help if needed. author: Esha
body: We had a great time at Hills Edge Villa with our group of friends. This is one of the best properties in Nandi Hills with fantastic views of the hills with no obstructions. The place was exactly as described. The host answered all our queries and helped us with food arrangement options also. We would highly recommend!

author: Vishal
body: Great and amazing place to stay near Bangalore! Peace and tranquility in surroundings, luxury in villa with amazing swimming pool and amenities. Food & BBQ is currently being available through a tie up with community kitchen nearby (to be paid extra) but the food was really great. The hosts, Chaitra and Jerome, are responsive and proactive. The caretaker Kushal is also very supportive, responsive, and humble. Must Recommend

author: Dilip
body: Although I couldn’t spend as much time at the property as I would have liked, as I was travelling for business, I would have loved to stay longer and properly unwind. The property is beautiful and makes for a perfect weekend getaway if you’re looking to relax, disconnect, and recharge. The host and the entire team were fantastic, especially when it came to the guest experience. Warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Would definitely love to come back for a longer stay next time!

author: Prathvi
body: The place was fantastic, extremely clean, and we had a great time. The host was generous for our requests. The food that we ordered for breakfast fast was yum. A must stay property.

author: Ashish
body: Had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout the stay. The location was convenient and the overall experience was smooth and hassle-free. Would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again!

author: Mahesh Kumar
body: It was great experience staying in Akaya collective. From check-in to check out we had a great experience. Host is very Helpful and very fast responsive. overall Great experience.

author: Arushi
body: We had a wonderful stay! The property was very spacious, thoughtfully designed, and had everything we needed for a comfortable getaway. The apartment was spotless, beautifully furnished, felt brand new, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The building itself was modern, clean, and secure, and the staff even helped us with our luggage. A special thanks to Isha, who was incredibly responsive and accommodating. She arranged an early check-in since our flight landed ahead of schedule, making our arrival completely stress-free. The location is excellent if you’re looking to stay close to the airport, but it’s not the most strategic area for sightseeing or nightlife. We had to drive around 30 minutes to reach places like the mall, although food delivery options were plentiful, so that wasn’t an issue for our short stay.

author: Ashutosh
body: Nice clean and spacious stay between airport and NMACC . Good price

author: Praharsh
body: Great stay. Smooth check in. Perfect for someone who's looking for a stay near the airport.

author: Karnikka
body: Loved the stay! It was right in the middle of the city with easy access to all attractions.  The place itself was quite comfortable and well maintained.  Special mention to Angelo for being so accommodative to our requests and being super responsive. Would highly recommend if you’re looking for a home like stay right in the heart of Pondy !

author: Kavyashri
body: Have absolutely adored the stay. Every place from markets to rock beach everything was pretty much at walkable distance. The house was kept clean and truly very Pinteresty and felt vintage yet modern. The host has been very responsive and if I ever visit Pondi again this is truly the place to stay and will recommend to anyone visiting the place too.

author: Joseph
body: The place was exactly as shown in the photos. Angelo was responsive all throughout the booking until checkout. Place was clean and easy to locate. You would not find a better place at Heritage town at this price bracket.

author: Harsh
body: The stay was amazing, very well maintained, and neat and clean. Everything required was already present. Mr. Angelo was also easy to communicate with. Would definitely recommend this place to others.

author: Prachi
body: Host/owner is very helpful and responsive, no matter what time you contact him. He was very accommodative to all our requests and needs. The stay has a very peaceful and homely vibe and is decorated very thoughtfully. Overall had a good experience.

author: Bhargav
body: I had a wonderful stay. The rooms were very clean, quiet, and comfortable. The location was close to the main city spots.

author: Simran
body: We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was comfortable, lively, and full of character — exactly what we hoped for. A special thanks to the host for the sweet gesture of welcoming us as their first guests, which made the experience even more memorable. The location is a big plus too, with easy connectivity to major tourist spots, making it so convenient to get around. We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! author: Kshitij
body: Absolutely loved our stay here! The wooden cottage was beautiful, cozy, and had an incredible view. The stay felt very homely and everything was thoughtfully arranged. The amenities made it super comfortable, and the private lawn was the cherry on top! A perfect place to unwind and enjoy the surroundings. Would happily stay here again!

author: Shashank
body: Had a fantastic time staying here. The wooden house is incredibly cozy and comfortable. The property looks exactly like it does in pictures, so there were no surprises. Hosts were amazing- very welcoming, helpful and attentive. Truly enjoyed the stay and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for relaxing or cozy gateway!!

author: Minal
body: Our stay was very comfortable and enjoyable. The property is nestled amidst beautiful greenery, making it a peaceful retreat. It's especially great for families, with toys and play options available for children. The surroundings are calm, the space is well-maintained, and it served as an excellent base for our Nandi Hills trip. We would happily stay here again.

author: Janani
body: Host was very responsive with our requirements She was also friendly and gave us flexibility with check out when we had genuine requirements. She had arranged for things that we asked beforehand. The property’s location is very convenient if you are travelling to Nandi Hills or chikbellapur or even Skandagiri. It’s a beautiful and peaceful, cozy place, perfect for a weekend getaway.

author: Rakshitha
body: Had a wonderful stay here! The place is peaceful, beautifully maintained, and surrounded by lush greenery, making it the perfect getaway from the city’s hustle. The wooden cottages are cozy, clean, and blend beautifully with nature. Prathibha was friendly and ensured we had everything we needed. If you’re looking for a quiet retreat to unwind and reconnect with nature, this is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended!

author: Faraz
body: Overall a very good experience. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. Everything was exactly as shown in the images, the property was beautiful and superbly maintained. It was peaceful and very comfortable, everything which was required for the stay was available. Highly recommend...

author: Sarah
body: The place looks like a dream with greenary on all sides and the view of the mountains. The host was very helpful and went the extra mile to make us comfortable. I would surely love visit here again.

author: Digesha
body: Host : Friendly, They made the check-in easy, good co-ordination to check if all’s in place and helpful in guiding us to the area around and good follow-up.

author: Aftab
body: Aftab and his group were wonderful guests—very understanding, respectful, and cooperative throughout their stay. It was truly a pleasure hosting them, and I would be very happy to welcome them back anytime. Highly recommended guests!

author: Abhijith
body: I am glad that you loved the villa Abhijith. We will always work to keep our guests happy and relaxed, hope we can host you again soon, Thankyou😊

author: Kathirvel
body: Thankyou so much kathir, it brings me great joy that you enjoyed White Haven and our hospitality, looking forward to seeing you again soon😊

author: Kartik
body: It was an amazing stay. The property was exactly the same as shown in the pictures. Aftab is a very charming guy who was available for us at any given hour. We even kept our luggage at his office and he was available at the office when we came to pick up our bags. He stay has very nice rooms the place was very clean. Thank you Aftab for an amazing experience

author: Jai
body: “Had a wonderful stay at this 2 BHK Airbnb apartment. The place was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos. The rooms were comfortable, the kitchen was well equipped. Check-in was smooth, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The location was convenient and perfect for families or small groups. Highly recommended, and I would definitely stay here again!”

author: Jamshed
body: I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb apartment. The place was beautiful, clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. Everything was arranged perfectly, and I genuinely enjoyed my visit. The host was extremely friendly, helpful, and professional, and provided excellent service throughout my stay. I really appreciated the hospitality and quick assistance whenever needed. Overall, it was a fantastic experience and felt like a home away from home. Highly recommended, and I would definitely love to stay here again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Tomz
body: Had a great stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, a very pleasant experience and I would definitely recommend this place.

author: Prathmesh Vilas
body: It took us 5/7 mins to find the location, but the property was too goood and worth the hassle, clean and quiet property, Infact the host was responsive with everything, will book again.

author: Khushboo
body: Lovely stay! The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was extremely supportive and helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely recommend it! 😊

author: Sankha
body: Aftab was a kind, helpful and responsive host. He was quick to arrange a technician when the lock stopped working, upgraded the internet so we could work comfortably, arranged cleaning when the washroom wasn't clean after the previous guests, and kindly accommodated a late checkout. We really appreciated how proactive he was whenever we raised an issue. The apartment is a nice new place with good internet, a functional kitchen, and a sturdy swing. However, future guests should be aware that we did encounter some issues. One wall had dampness with plaster coming off, and we also had problems with cockroaches during our stay. Overall, Aftab made a genuine effort to make our stay comfortable and was very receptive to feedback. The apartment has good potential, and with some attention to maintenance and pest control, it could be a great stay.

author: Raj
body: Very cozy and clean stay. Would always choose to stay here. Near from the airport.

author: Tharun
body: The place was so peaceful and private. The stay was exactly the same in pictures and was clean and tidy. Amith was the so helpful and communicative . Great stay and moreover a great host! Will definitely come back and i highly recommend for anyone coming with friends or family.

author: Harshit
body: Wild Castle is nice place to stay into the wilds with greenery all around, stay was beautiful and owner is very helpful and available all the time and make sure the guest are comfortable.

author: Rahul
body: An amazing place surrounded by forest- calm, peaceful, and secluded. Our host, Amith, was exceptionally helpful throughout our stay; he went out of his way to assist us and recommended some fantastic local spots to eat.

author: Sneha
body: We had a wonderful stay! 🌿✨ The place was absolutely beautiful, peaceful, and surrounded by stunning greenery and views. The host was incredibly friendly, kind, and helpful—not only during our stay but also with suggestions for exploring nearby places. The hospitality and warm conversations made our experience even more special. Highly recommend this stay to anyone visiting Wayanad who wants to enjoy nature, beautiful views, and a peaceful getaway. 🤍🌿⛰️

author: Viren
body: Exactly like the pictures and was a peaceful and private stay. Well maintained and the host Amit is extremely helpful.

author: Shravan
body: We had a wonderful experience at this stay. The property is located inside an estate, right in the midst of the jungle, which makes the whole experience truly unique. We even spotted a few elephants on the way to the property, which added an incredible thrill to the trip! The place is exactly as described, and the way the stay is built blends beautifully with its surroundings. It’s an ideal choice for a group of 5–6 people looking for something peaceful, adventurous, and different from a typical stay. The host, Amith, was an absolute gentleman. He was very helpful throughout our stay, especially with arranging food orders and suggesting nearby tourist attractions. Amith was also in the process of building a swimming pool, which, according to him, should be completed in a few months. I’m sure that will be a fantastic addition to an already wonderful property. Overall, it was a unique and memorable experience. Definitely recommended, and an easy 5/5! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
