body: Thank u mam and i m very much happy to host u once again

author: Mayank
body: Thanks a lot sir i am very much happy to host u once again

author: Arun
body: The kitchen is fully functional with fridge, washing machine and all utensils, which made it so convenient for us. Location is a big plus - market is nearby and Mysuru Palace is very close. Great host, smooth check-in.

author: Mohammed
body: Really enjoyed our stay here. The location is honestly the best thing about this place — the zoo is just in front of the property, so you can’t really ask for a better location in Mysore. The house was clean, spacious and really nice. Nadir was also a very good host and helped us whenever we needed anything. Had a really good stay and would definitely come back again.

author: M
body: Overall this is great place to stay.. highly recommend if you are planning for a stay in Mysore..

author: Haleemath
body: Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Mysuru. We would be happy to stay here again! ❤️

author: Sainul
body: I am very happy! It is wonderful to know that the house was clean, beautiful, budget-friendly, and equipped with all amenities.Thank you so much for your kind words and feedback! Hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again. Have a great time!"

author: Rahul Rathnakaran
body: The location was excellent, very close to the city centre and easily accessible. The place itself was exceptionally clean and comfortable, making us feel right at home. We especially loved the beautiful view right through the bedroom windows. ​Our host, Suria, was warm, welcoming, and highly responsive throughout our stay. Highly recommended!

author: Zeeshan
body: We had an amazing stay at this beautiful Airbnb in Ooty! The property is tastefully designed, and surrounded by breathtaking views that made every morning special. The rooms were spacious, cozy, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was peaceful yet conveniently close to the main attractions. If you're looking for a relaxing getaway in Ooty with stunning scenery, I highly recommend this place. We would definitely love to stay here again!

author: Zing
body: This is a home away from home n a little heaven. Peaceful quite, beautiful landscapes and view. Professional host, Helpful Caretaker and Independent house. Very clean n helpful staff. Thank u suria bhai.🙏

author: Suraj
body: It was a wonderful stay. The host’s father was incredibly kind and welcoming. He personally greeted us upon arrival and showed us around the rooms. Arul was very helpful, responsive, and always available whenever we needed assistance. The location was excellent, with the market, Botanical Garden, and Rose Garden all conveniently nearby. Overall, it was a pleasant and comfortable experience.

author: Rahul
body: We had a wonderful stay! The views from every single room were absolutely stunning, especially the sunrise and sunset. The kitchen was excellent and equipped with really useful utensils, which was perfect for our family. A special thanks to the caretaker, who went the extra mile to make our stay great. A perfect spot for anyone looking for incredible scenery and top-notch hospitality.

author: Rajeswar
body: The property is located in a very peaceful locality which overlooks the picturesque hills. I personally loved the stay and also its pet friendly and my pet lab also found it very comforting. would highly recommend this

author: Ayush
body: We had a wonderful stay and thoroughly enjoyed our time here. The property was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. A special mention to the caretaker, who was exceptionally helpful, friendly, and attentive throughout our stay.

author: Rituraj
body: A beautiful home like place located at just 1.5 to 2km away from the Ooty city centre gives you an awesome view of the entire valley. We had a lovely stay along with our pet Zoro (beagle) who loved the place a lot as they had ample space around the compound and all are pet friendly people. You will get all basic and necessary things inside the property itself. Suria himself I found a lovely gentleman and welcoming. Take his suggestion to decide what to do in Ooty and I am sure you won’t get disappointed. Look forward to visit again soon. Cheers !

author: Sukesha
body: We had a wonderful stay at Hornbill Roost with family and friends. The property is peaceful and away from the main road. The house was clean, well-equipped, and had a fun play area for kids and adults. Clear labeling and helpful details made things easy. The host was very responsive and friendly, suggested some great places, and quickly provided any details we needed. A perfect spot for a relaxing getaway.

author: Sameer
body: The only regret that we booked this stay for a day. The stay and the surroundings require atleast 2-3 days for one to fully immerse. Coming from a metro city , its a no fuss zone. Occasionally you will hear a bike or auto, otherwise its the birds chirping all day. The phantom rock view from the 2nd floor keeps you in awe throughout. Waiting for my next holiday to return back to this place.

author: Arun
body: A big shout out to the host for his warm hospitality and amazing breakfast every morning - it really made our stay special. Overall a very beautiful stay, we will surely come again. Highly recommended!

author: Rohit
body: Really enjoyed our stay! I came here with a couple of friends for the weekend, and we had a fantastic time. The place had pretty much everything we could ask for, and our host, Bichulal, was incredibly helpful, especially with recommendations for nearby food spots. The complimentary authentic Kerala breakfast was absolutely amazing, and we loved the great selection of games available at the property. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone, whether you’re travelling with friends or family.

author: Tanaya
body: I stayed at bichulal's place with my family and I never felt that I am not at my own home. The stay was so cozy and comfortable with all the possible amenities that could be provided. The scenic view was the cherry on the top. The stay was a full package for someone who are looking for a peaceful yet scenic stay in wayanad away from the city chaos. Last but not the least they served us with such awesome and tasty breakfast. We just loved the stay...

author: Shaikh Mohammed
body: Had an incredible stay at Hornbill Roost. The property is beautiful, serene, and completely surrounded by nature,exactly what you need to unwind. The hospitality was exceptional.The host Bichu and his dad James go out of their way to make you feel welcome and comfortable. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and peaceful.

author: Sanmoy
body: The place though a but remote and tough to reach was immaculate and beautifully located. The views were great and the rooms were clean and spacious. The caretaker was friendly as well.

author: Prashanth
body: Host is unresponsive, finally we had find caretaker number through Airbnb support personnel, the given location is wrong. The property is good and caretaker was responsive enough for the rest of the period. Even though it is a villa, steps are outside and of iron stairs, not easy for kids and seniors. Location is near to city trade mark places. Response from Pooja May 2026 Hi Prashanth, my sincere apologies for the inconvenience. There was a issue with the with the notification settings on the airbnb app due to which I missed these messages.

author: Chandan
body: Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The location is beautiful, surrounded by a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere that makes it a perfect getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. The property is well situated, offering a calm and refreshing experience. The road leading to the property is a bit narrow, so it’s best to drive carefully, but it is completely manageable and well worth it once you arrive. Overall, we had a fantastic stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet and scenic retreat.

author: Naveen
body: Homestay was excellent. Good location  closer to Raja Seat and market. Well suited for family stay, felt like a home. Everything was good, only drawback being bedroom in upper floor became inaccessible during rains as the steel stairs to go there was in open from outside. So we along with kid had to adjust in lower floor itself which has only Queen beds. Home food suggested by them was very good. Host's response was prompt. Overall an excellent stay.

author: Ghanashyam
body: We had a great stay at The Nook. It is located very close to the city center, but it is still incredibly peaceful. The only minor downside is the narrow approach roads, but everything else was perfect. The host was very proactive and shared the caretaker's contact details well in advance. The caretaker was also very friendly, kept the place clean, and gave us excellent recommendations for local activities. We definitely recommend this place for large groups. It can easily accommodate 10 people. Response from Pooja June 2026 Thank you so much for your lovely review Ghanashyam. I am glad you enjoyed your stay at The Nook and found it peaceful despite being close to the city. It was a pleasure hosting your group. 😊 Thank you as well for pointing out the electrical issue and the cooler problem. We will get both checked right away. Hope to welcome you back again soon! Show more

author: Preeti
body: We recently stayed at The Nook Homestay. The property itself is spacious, clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Although our booking didn't include kitchen access, the hosts were kind enough to let us use it, which we appreciated. That said, we felt the hospitality could have been better. During a previous stay at another homestay, the hosts were very proactive—they checked in with us before our arrival, asked about our travel plans, and stayed in touch throughout our trip. Compared to that experience, the communication here felt lacking. We tried contacting Pooja several times, but it was difficult to reach her. She shared the caretaker's contact, but there wasn't much follow-up from either of them. The caretaker also wasn't aware of the duration of our stay, which made things feel a bit uncoordinated. The homestay provides the contact of someone who prepares home-cooked meals, but when we reached out, he was unavailable and couldn't provide the service.

author: Vinayak
body: The stay was overall good and comfortable. The place was clean, well maintained, and exactly as described by the host. However, the location is not very private, and the approach roads are quite narrow, which can be a bit inconvenient. Apart from this, everything else was good and we had a pleasant stay.

author: Vigneshwar
body: The stay was really nice . we were there for 3 nights and stay was comfortable . The rooms were clean and spacious. The location was near to most of tourist spot in madikeri.There is no food facility but care taker gave us a contact who provided home food. It was very good

author: Sumanth
body: I have no objection to say this is the best stay you can find in wayanad, if you are 2-5 people with a personal vehicle looking for a peaceful stay, just go ahead with this place, trust me the photos do not do justice to how beautiful this place is, it’s worth every penny and the pool and backyard area is simply amazing, the star of the show is the private waterfall which is just 15 steps down and it’s just perfect

author: Aashish
body: Fawz's place is a goto leisure destination with private pool, waterfall outside dining area and other things. Checkin was smooth, place was clean. Host is also proactive provided local recommendation, places to visit prior to arrival. Local food provided by neighbor aunt was also tasty. Overall it was a nice experience.

author: Rishi
body: Insanely beautiful place. Especially the waterfall was just the right amount and for the duration that we went it was exclusively available for us. The host arranged for us getting there and dropping us off as well. Food was arranged on time. the atmosphere felt so perfect. We just stayed in and enjoyed the plunge pool and the waterfall and the carrom board in the terrace. Try to get snacks before you go there as it might be hard to get night.

author: Priya
body: Place is very serene and beautiful. Overall the stay was good. Food was also home cooked and good. Hot water was an issue the first day but it was sorted out. There should be provision for biodegradable toothbrushes. Bed linen and bathroom towels should be replaced on a daily basis. Also adequate milk powder sachets should be provided considering the length of a guest’s stay. Dishwasher and washing machine provision for guests to operate would be great. Overall recommended. Response from Fawz July 2026 Thank you for your thoughtful review and for appreciating the peaceful surroundings and our home-cooked food. We’re glad the hot water issue was resolved quickly. Nature’s Lap is a simple, minimalist farmstay offering a clean, well-maintained stay immersed in nature, rather than the facilities and services of a hotel or resort. Amenities like daily linen and towel changes or guest-operated appliances are therefore not part of the experience. We also don’t provide disposable toiletries, including biodegradable toothbrushes, as we believe personal care items are best brought by guests and taken back with them to reduce unnecessary waste. We always encourage guests to read our listing carefully or contact us before booking if they have specific requirements, so they can ensure our farmstay is the right fit for their stay. Thank you again for your feedback and suggestions. Show more

body: loved the place , the waterfall, natural pool was surreal.All amenities were provided as mentioned. The best thing was the home cooked keralian food by the sweet neighbour aunty at a nominal price.

body: It’s an awesome property, you will literally feel like you are in the lap of nature Ment for a family of 4 or 5 Swimming pool is small but best part is that it’s chlorine free, (natural pool) Property has a natural and private waterfall Outdoor seating area is also nice Host and caretaker are also very cooperative and they ensure a comfortable stay

Everything was as expected, which made our stay really pleasant and hassle-free. The host was also very responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay! 😊 Response from Mohan Nagesh Shenoy 3 weeks ago Thank you so much for the fantastic review! body: Ganesh sir was very helpful, he let us check in at 2:00am and he was waiting for us to arrive Got tea and biscuits in the morning  and even after checking out he let our luggage stay at his personal place and in the evening while leaving it was raining heavily and he knew a auto stand, so he himself went to auto stand to get an auto for us He was really helpful and friendly 😊

author: Suman
body: It was nice trip, for 3 days with family,  every morning tea  from host brings added flavours, but for dinner to order thru Swiggy and zomato need to complete by 2030 hrs as clses 2100 hrs sharp At the age of 77 Mr Ganesh is very fit person to help guest as always, praying God to keep going as always

author: Anagha
body: Our stay at this beautiful house with a group of six was a wonderful experience. The house, located on the first floor, features spacious bedrooms, a hall, and excellent kitchen facilities. The interior is extremely clean and has a wonderfully peaceful atmosphere. Because the location is in Madikeri town, it was very easy to reach everywhere quickly. The host's approach was very friendly, and their care in providing us with their own umbrellas when we went out in the rain is unforgettable. This house is highly recommended to anyone.

author: Manjunath
body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We had an amazing stay! The property was clean, well-maintained, peaceful, and perfect for a relaxing getaway with family and friends. The rooms were comfortable, and all the amenities were thoughtfully arranged. A very special thanks to Ganesh for his exceptional hospitality. He was incredibly friendly, responsive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our stay. His warm welcome and willingness to help made our experience even more memorable. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free stay. We would definitely love to visit again!

author: Sanil
body: Good, helpful and friendly host. Good and safe place to stay with family, friends and kids, street car parking but safe. Its located in Madikeri so easy to get access to the restaurants and tourist spots. 1.5 kms from Raja seat view

author: Manas
body: Had a wonderful stay here! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. A special mention to the hosts for their warm hospitality they made us feel right at home. Would definitely love to come back and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting!

author: Santvana
body: We were a group of 6 people and we fit in just fine. There were a few more rules than usual, as it's a homestay in a residential area. The host was accomodative of different needs and even made changes to the booking date for our need.

author: Juliet
body: He was incredibly helpful throughout our stay and made sure we were well taken care of. Every day, he served us fresh, hot tea along with biscuits, which added such a warm touch to our experience. We truly enjoyed our time here and felt very comfortable. Thank you for the lovely hospitality. We would definitely love to visit again if we get the chance!

author: Surojit
body: this place is just as beautiful as the pictures, It's tastefully decorated with art, and every corner is perfect for enjoying a quiet moment... located in the heart of White Town, it's an easy walk to pretty much everything in the area,, the homemade breakfast was delicious and served with such care.... highly recommend this spot for families and slow travelers...

author: Priya
body: "An exceptional stay at Shubham Boutique Homestay! The property seamlessly blends beauty and comfort, and the rooms are top-notch. The staff went above and beyond, making us feel right at home. A special shoutout to the amazing complimentary breakfast. We arrived at 6:00 AM—way ahead of the 1:00 PM check-in—but they warmly accommodated us by letting us store our luggage and freshen up. Highly recommended!"

author: Arsh
body: This place is a for sure completely package. From the location to its hospitality everything is top notch. The host and the entire team is excellent. Host is very accommodating to each m every need. The best part about it is the breakfast and the pool which are the main highlights of the space. A special thanks to the host for understanding our concern and helping us provide the resolution to it.

author: Sudeshna
body: Place matched the description exactly. Tasteful decor, warm ambience. The place is distinctive, classical and aligned with the hosts personal style and profile. Service is great, the personnel managing the setup, right from check in to the ladies preparing and serving quality food and the in charge of the place, all were consistently warm, professional and added to our stay experience. We were able to find the right balance between privacy and hospitality and the experience was great!

author: Trishnala
body: Our stay at Shubham Homestay was beautiful. The stunning curation of artefacts, extremely responsive host and staff, and peaceful interiors provided a haven for us in the heat and noise outside. The proximity to all key highlights within white town was a plus. We loved the indoor pool set-up too. Devasmita was super helpful in providing us with all details that made our stay easy and comfortable. Lataji, Ushaji, and Venkat were fantastic staff. Would highly recommend!

author: Arun Stanlin Pinto
body: I had a wonderful stay at Feel at Home Stay. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff were friendly and helpful, making the experience truly feel like home. Great location and excellent hospitality. I would definitely recommend it and look forward to staying again.

author: Sujeet
body: I would highly recommend this place to families and would be happy to stay here again!

author: Clr
body: It was a wonderful place to stay! The property was very clean, and all the amenities mentioned in the listing were available as promised. We had a comfortable and pleasant stay. The host provided clear directions and instructions, making it easy to reach the property, even though we arrived late. Overall, we are very happy with our experience and would definitely recommend this stay to others.

author: Radhika
body: A little far from the railway station, but closer to malls, beaches, food joints, bus/auto stands which makes it an ideal choice. Clean, spacious, well ventilated and feel at home/home away from home kind of place. We, a group of 5 friends stayed in this 3bhk home for one night, and  recommend this place if you are looking for a place to stay in Mangalore. Host Sushma is approachable and responsive.

author: Deepesh
body: All in all a great place for families.

author: Pruthvika
body: Had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The host was responsive. Overall, a great experience and would happily stay here again! ⭐️

author: Kaushik
body: Sushma was an amazing host. We checked in late at 1:20am and she was there to receive us and check us in. The place was pristine, clean and cozy. Loved our stay and would love to come back when we're in town.

author: Sameeksha
body: Sushma was extremely accomodating about our late arrival, and was able to guide us with ease. The property was lovely, and extremely clean. All the amenities were provided, and we were able to have a relaxing time.

author: Phanibhushan
body: We had travelled as family and its a great place to stay, Good  Neighborhood and Right in the center of city and good restaurants near by. Perfect place if you want to travel around the city and come back and relax

author: Anil
body: Had a wonderful stay at this location. The property was very neat, clean, and well-maintained throughout our visit. The caretaker was extremely helpful and attentive, and the owner was friendly and responsive. One of the best things about this place is its excellent location, with many shops, restaurants, and attractions nearby, all within walking distance. Overall, it was a comfortable and hassle-free stay, and I would gladly recommend it to others. Response from Meena June 2026 Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your stay and had a pleasant experience at our property. Your kind words about the cleanliness mean a lot to us, as we take great pride in maintaining high standards for our guests. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we truly appreciate your feedback. We look forward to welcoming you back again in the future.” Show more

author: Vaidehi
body: We stayed there with cousins and 3 senior citizens and they absolutely loved the place. Very scenic and good open space. Host and housekeeper were very helpful and supportive. Loved staying there. Response from Meena April 2026 Thank you mam for taking your time to review our property . Very happy to know you’ll enjoyed the scenic and quiet atmosphere of our property . Wishing you a safe journey back to Canada.

author: Eshita
body: We got a great deal compared to the experience. It was private and quite.Special mention to Balan, who is a great great neighbour taking care of the house and the guest. He is always responsive and very active. He always provided what we asked for. He made sure we were warm and comfortable. Rida, the owner was also always responsive and helpful. Don't expect a modern stay if you want to book Beulah cottage. We wanted to feel the chills and rawness of Ooty in a heritage home which is exactly was this place is.

author: Utkarsh
body: The cottage is good and the surrounding is peaceful with literally no noise. You will wake up with the sound of birds. The host and his neighbour both are very responsive and friendly. Major attractions are very near to the place. The approach road is narrow as mentioned by the host. Be prepared.

author: Akash
body: we stayed for 3 days and feel like it is second home. Home is preserved with antiques and gives vintage feel. peaceful surroundings and not far from city make it a perfect getaway in mountains. Also Balan is very supportive and always available whenever required

author: Maria
body: Beautiful place with such a warm and cozy cottage — it truly felt like a home away from home. The space is beautifully decorated, and Heber sir’s collection of books and antique pieces adds so much charm and character to the stay. The fireplace sets just the right mood and makes the whole experience even more special. A special mention to Balan sir, who helped us throughout our stay. He was incredibly friendly, kind, and always approachable. We genuinely enjoyed talking to him. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a peaceful and memorable getaway!

author: Vidhi
body: I had such a wonderful experience staying here. The place was spotless and exactly as shown in the photos, maybe even better. Check-in was smooth and the host was super responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone visiting. Thank you for a lovely stay!

author: Praneetha
body: The place is close to main city centre but still in a calm surroundings! The vintage look of the place has been preserved really well! The city view once it gets dark is beautiful to view from the cottage!

author: Atul
body: Heber was very cooperative and helpful. The plus point is its fireplace. We enjoyed it both the days during our stay. Those who love a vintage feel, this is the perfect place for you.

author: Abhyuday
body: We stayed for 2 nights at this beautiful cottage while exploring Ooty, and I cannot recommend it enough! Heber is a kind and responsive host, and the place is very well located away from the main traffic but still close enough to get to all the main attractions quickly. The house is well equipped , as described, and the fireplace is a must-experience, perfect for cold nights. Would love to come back again and again for longer stays.

author: Joyson
body: Stayed at Rajeshwari's home - location was very convenient and centrally located with easy access to everything. The house was clean and well-maintained. The infrastructure is a bit old but completely workable and functional. Overall very good value for the price paid, would recommend for a budget-friendly stay.

author: Yashas
body: Had a great stay at this beautiful home. It is in the center of mangalore and has various things that are easily accessible. Especially the restaurants are very high in number around the area. Very well maintained and is clean. The building may not give off a "grandeur" vibe but the flat is absolutely worth it.

author: Bijoy
body: Staying at this property was an absolute delight, thanks to Rajeshwari (host) who was incredibly understanding, supportive, and flexible throughout our trip. The location was fantastic, offering easy access to everything while still providing a peaceful retreat. Furthermore, the property was exceptionally well-maintained, spotless, and equipped with every comfort imaginable. I would gladly stay here again!

author: Rajaneesh
body: Apartment is very well maintained and the interiors are done well.The apartment complex and corridor needs better maintenance.I understand that it is not directly the host's responsibility but that of the apartment complex's management committee.However apart from that the stay was very comfortable with all amenities provided as promised.

author: Kumar
body: Commute help- One info -  local auto rickshawala being greedy always asking 1.5 x from meter.

author: Fasil
body: We had a great stay at this property. The check-in was very smooth and hassle-free. The host was very responsive to all our queries and provided clear communication throughout our stay. Everything was accurately described in the listing, with all details clearly mentioned beforehand. The rooms were nice, clean, and well-maintained, and all the amenities were available as advertised. The location is also convenient, with good restaurants nearby. Overall, a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend this place to other travelers especially for family.

author: Hanumanthappa
body: The space was clean,comfortable and exactly as described. The host was fantastic—super easy to reach and very helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely stay here again!

author: Ramkumar
body: The property is clean, well maintained. easily accable for hotels and super market, super comfortable. I recommend this property for a comfortable stay for a family of 6.

author: Ayesha
body: The Maahi pool villa was a perfect choice for our family getaway. It perfectly fitted our requirement for a peaceful getaway surrounded by nature. The property is very well equipped with all the amenities and the host was more than helpful in sharing all the recommendations and to answer all our queries before and during the stay. The cleanliness of the villa was spotless. Highly recommended this place!!!!

author: Satyajit
body: , · Stayed with kids We had a fantastic stay at this beautiful 4-bedroom villa while celebrating my dad’s birthday with the family. The villa was spacious, well-maintained, and had a lovely pool and plenty of fun amenities that kept the kids entertained. It was the perfect place to relax, celebrate, and create wonderful family memories. Highly recommended!

author: Harish
body: Excelling place for party and comfortable stay Good assistance from the caretaker he was helpful in procuring certain necessary things Good food from - meal plan - Mr pavan They have served delicious hot food during the entire party time Cattering to our needs The food service was a surprise as there is a shortage of gas now Still they have managed to delivery many items on time Thanks

author: Abhijit
body: A really good place for relaxing with friends or families. Mahima was helpful and responsive. The caretaker was friendly and polite. Great property. Beautiful surroundings.

author: Avinash
body: Great place to stay, clean pool , good place to enjoy with friends and have fun time with beautiful surroundings and well maintained place. Place close to airport too as compared to city

author: Pritam
body: The villa was tastefully decorated and was impeccably cldan. Mahima helped us out through out the process and the check in and check out process were a breeze. Had a wonderful stay. Lakshmana was also of great help.

author: Nimisha
body: It was a great place with amazing surroundings. The villa was very neat and clean and exactly how it was described. Highly recommended.

author: Manjari
body: We had a nice weekend getaway with friends and had an amazing time. Place was nice and we could also arrange dinner and breakfast with some extra cost. Host Mahima provided all information in advance which made everything easy to navigate.

author: Aatif
body: 2. property has only 2 toilets and could feel cramped for bigger sized people.

author: Christine
body: We had a very nice time at Alex’s place ! The house is really big and offer all the comfort needed for a family or group of friends. Beautiful decoration inside, and most important, super location, you can walk to any cafe, restaurant or place to visit. The house was very clean too and the manager so helpful. Definitely recommended. 🙏🏻

author: Aliasgar
body: We had a wonderful 3-night stay. The property was spacious enough to accommodate all of us comfortably. The place was clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. Overall, it was a comfortable and enjoyable experience. We'd definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a spacious and pleasant stay.

author: Praharsha
body: A great place to chill. it is 400mts from the sea shore..it is not near a beach. just a shore where we can't enter the water. it is walkable distance to railway station which is a huge plus point. all trending cafes are also walkable the manager is always accessible. the house is clean. it can easily accommodate 10 guests the house is dimly lit, wish there was more light esp in bedrooms and dining. great place overall.

author: Himabindu
body: Place was beautiful and walkable distance to the beach...we didn't want to leave the house...the house itself felt like little Frenchtown...manager Muthu was very kind ..suggested pretty good restaurants..and cafés.

author: Mike & Rachel
body: , · Group trip Heritage type house with a spacious layout. Walking distance to all the eating places and the rock beach... rock beach btw, nice place to walk or run in the mornings. House was super clean. AC's worked great. The manager Muthu was very accessible and helpful.

author: Amogh
body: We had stayed there from 5/6/26-9/6/26 and had an amazing stay over there.Stay was very good,clean,easy accessible and was near to most.Alex was amazing and super responsive. Would recommend to everyone whoever visit to pondicherry.

author: Aarav
body: The stay was unproblematic, check-in was very smooth and whatever issues we faced Muthu was there to help us through it  It was an enjoyable vacation and we had lots of fun.

author: Sahithi
body: We had a great stay at this property. The Property was very clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The location is excellent, with easy access to nearby attractions while still being peaceful and relaxing.Antara was responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making the entire experience smooth and hassle-free. Overall, a wonderful place to stay and highly recommended!

author: Karthick
body: We had a very pleasant stay at Chickoo Tree.  We were a family of 5 and we felt it's an another home of ours.  The place was very well maintained and peaceful. we loved the Ambience, lighting and the condition of the property. And special thanks to the host,  Mrs.Antara who was very helpful and supportive. This will be our goto place hereafter when we visit Goa!!

author: Antino
body: The stay was really well maintained, and Antara was very responsive and made sure we had a smooth check-in process. We really enjoyed our stay and liked the place, that we decided to extend for another day.

author: Pulkit
body: We had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, spacious, and very comfortable. The rooms were well-maintained, the amenities were excellent, and everything we needed was available. The location was perfect for exploring Goa, with easy access to beaches, restaurants, and local attractions. The host was friendly, responsive, and made sure we had a smooth check-in and a hassle-free stay. Overall, it was one of the best and most comfortable stays we've had in Goa. Highly recommended, and we'd definitely love to stay here again!

author: Suraj
body: We had a wonderful stay at Antara’s Airbnb in Goa! The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The location was convenient and peaceful, making it a great place to relax after exploring Goa. Antara was a kind and responsive host who made the check-in process smooth and was always available to help with any questions. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Goa. Thank you for making our trip memorable! Thankyou ❤️

author: Samidha
body: Absolutely loved the stay! Super close to beach, cafés and a lot of other eateries yet very peaceful! Antara is a wonderful host. Very proactive and sweet. I wouldn’t think twice before booking this place again on my next visit too.

author: Srikanth
body: We had a wonderful stay. Antara was incredibly proactive, responsive, and always available whenever we needed anything. She went above and beyond by recommending some of the best food spots and places to visit in and around Calangute, which made our trip even better. She was also very flexible with our requests and genuinely friendly throughout our stay. The property was exactly as described, and her hospitality made us feel very welcome. Highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Goa!

author: Karthika
body: Chickoo Tree Villa  was everything we wanted it to be - Cozy, colourful,  comfortable, spacious and clean. It was exactly like in the pictures. The kitchen had all the required amenities and we loved the welcome hamper. The bathrooms were spotless and we had no problems during our stay. Both bedrooms were spacious and homey. The prime location allowed us to explore plenty of eateries, we even walked to a few. Apart from its utilitarian appeal, we personally loved the way the villa was decorated. Every corner told a story with its intricate figurines and posters. It's always heart-warming to live in a house with character. Its like we are now a part of its story. As for Antara our host, she was fantastic. Responsive to all messages and provided us all the info we needed. Friendly and easily accessible but not intrusive. Super Host for sure. Also thanks to Halima Didi for checking in if required anything. Chickoo Tree Villa, you have our heart!
